Excerpts of the Norwegian food composition table (Matvaretabellen), English JSON API, used by
`tests/test_intl_ciqual_norway.py`.

Source: Matvaretabellen. Mattilsynet (Norwegian Food Safety Authority). www.matvaretabellen.no.
Licence: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Downloaded on 2026-10-30 from https://www.matvaretabellen.no/api/en/ and trimmed; records are unchanged:

- `foods.json` (foods.json): foods 01.236, 05.130, 05.394, 06.178, 06.758 and 10.137.
- `food-groups.json` (food-groups.json): those foods' groups and their parent groups.
- `sources.json` (sources.json): the source references those foods use.
- `nutrients.json` (nutrients.json): complete.
